text:
incident-bot: Page fired: PD alert latency_p99_eu_west_v2 > 3.2s (threshold=3s). count=87 in 5m. Pager: pagerduty
amber: acked. I'm on it.
ryan: on rotation, handing to @amber — have a quick heads-up.
amber: quick status — we rolled a routing change to v2 at ~01:30 UTC. Suspect regional routing weight or v2 hotpath. Can someone check autoscale events and recent config pushes?
lia: checking autoscaler + infra logs... no scale events, but sidecar queue depth spiking on eu-west nodes: 
```
node: sidecar-proxy-eu-3
queue_length: 430 -> 1800
p95_latency_ms: 1500 -> 3200
connections: 1200 -> 2200
```
sam: can we shift some traffic to dedicated pool (dedicated-eu-lowlat)? I can change route weights.
amber: yes, start with 10% then 50% then full rollback if stable.
sam: executing: `/ops route weight set inference-eu v2->v1 10%`
ops-bot: route update accepted: inference-eu weights now v2:90, v1:10
amber: monitoring metrics... p99 dropped to ~2.1s after the 10% shift. Good sign — proceed to 50%.
sam: executing: `/ops route weight set inference-eu v2->v1 50%`
ops-bot: route update accepted: inference-eu weights now v2:50, v1:50
amber: p99 now ~1.8s, p95 stabilized under 900ms. Looks like v2 path causing tail latency. We'll keep v1 at 50% while we triage.
ryan: filing follow-up ticket — probable causes: model variant memory growth, KV cache coldstart, or priority inversion in sidecar. @lia can you capture heap and perf counters for v2 pods?
lia: on it — collecting `jstack`/heap and sidecar logs. Found repeated GC spikes around the tail times and a repeating `cache_miss` flood.
amber: mitigation summary: immediate traffic shift to v1 reduced p99 below threshold; no 5xx observed so no functional error, customer experience degraded for ~12 minutes for some EU customers. If this persists beyond 1h we'll send a customer bulletin.
ryan: action items — rollback v2 routing in prod, add KV cache warmup in canary, reproduce memory profile in staging, add surge autoscale policy for sidecar.
ops-bot: rollback action applied: inference-eu weights set v2:0, v1:100
pagerduty: Alert recovered at 1723344730 — incident closed automatically. :white_check_mark:
amber: closing thread, assigning postmortem to @ryan and @lia. I'll add notes to the incident board and schedule follow-up sync.
